description.value:
You gather and compress an enormous sphere of biotic dark energy and hurl it forward in a slow-moving but catastrophically destructive projectile.

You launch a Flare projectile at a point within 60 feet. On impact, it detonates in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-foot radius burst}. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-flare] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Half damage.

Success Full damage.

Failure @Damage[(6*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage. Any Biotic Barriers in the area are immediately depleted.

Critical Failure @Damage[(12*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage, all Biotic Barriers depleted, and targets are knocked prone.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
